question: What is the meaning of material efficiency in relation to material information?
description: Material efficiency in relation to material information refers to the ability to optimize the use of materials by having detailed and comprehensive data on their properties, dimensions, locations, and circularity level. This information allows for a better understanding of the materials within buildings, enabling informed decisions on reusing and recycling flows. By having a clear documentation of materials, it becomes possible to match supply and demand for re-use and recycling, ultimately maximizing the value and utility of materials over time.
